input: Set up an emergency contact card in my wallet

gold.taskTitle: Set Up Emergency Contact Card in Wallet
gold.taskDescription: Create and place a physical emergency contact card inside the user's wallet for quick access in urgent situations.

questions.title: Which people should be listed as emergency contacts?
questions.description: Identify the specific individuals (e.g., spouse, parent, close friend, doctor) the user wants listed on the card.

questions.title: How many contacts should the card include?
questions.description: Determine the total number of people to be listed so the card layout can be planned accordingly.

questions.title: What medical information should appear on the card?
questions.description: Find out if the user wants to include details such as blood type, allergies, medications, or medical conditions.

questions.title: Should the card be handwritten or professionally printed?
questions.description: Clarify whether the user wants a simple handwritten card, a home-printed version, or a professionally made card.

questions.title: What size must the card be to fit the wallet?
questions.description: Determine the physical dimensions required so the finished card fits neatly inside the wallet slot.

questions.title: Should the card be laminated for durability?
questions.description: Establish whether the user wants to laminate the card to protect it from wear, water, or tearing over time.

questions.title: Is this card also for a child or dependent, not yourself?
questions.description: Clarify who the card is intended for, as this affects whose information and contacts need to be included.
